title: Free-category comonad and its iterated counit
statement: For a small ordinary category $C$ [def-nagata-category], the free-category comonad $F$ has the same objects as $C$ and has as arrows finite composable words in the nonidentity arrows of $C$, including empty identity words. A functor $u$ sends a generator $[c]$ to $[u(c)]$ when $u(c)$ is nonidentity, and to the empty word otherwise. The counit $\epsilon_C:FC\to C$ composes words, and the comultiplication $\delta_C:FC\to F^2C$ sends $[c]$ to $[[c]]$. Define the powers $F^0=\mathrm{id}$ and $F^{n+1}=F^n\circ F$, together with their canonical unchanged-object maps $C\to\operatorname{Ob}(F^nC)$ and the iterated counit $F^nC\to C$ that composes all nested words.
